C135.name: Mwanza City Council
C135.documented: Lake Victoria floods (Mkuyuni and shore roads recorded in 2025), large waves, boat accidents, heavy rain, and cholera

area.en: Mwanza City: rocky hillsides and lakeshore
area.sw: Jiji la Mwanza: milima ya mawe na ufukwe

risk.en: This area is a lake city built on rocky hills where boulders can fall in heavy rain, run-off floods low streets and the lakeshore, and dense settlements spread cholera.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni jiji la ziwani lililojengwa kwenye milima ya mawe ambapo miamba inaweza kuanguka wakati wa mvua kubwa, maji hufurika mitaa ya chini na ufukwe, na makazi yenye msongamano husambaza kipindupindu.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it is safer not to build below loose boulders, keep drains open, and use safe water and latrines. What raises the risk: building under loose boulders or on cut rock faces, filling the drains with waste, and drawing water from the shore where latrines overflow. Know the firm ground away from the boulders and the higher street away from the flooded valley that you will move to, go there when heavy rain sets in on the hills, and report the first case of watery diarrhoea the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kutojenga chini ya miamba iliyolegea, kuweka mitaro wazi, na kutumia maji salama na vyoo. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga chini ya miamba iliyolegea au kwenye nyuso za mawe zilizochongwa, kujaza mitaro taka, na kuchota maji ufukweni ambako vyoo hufurika. Fahamu eneo imara mbali na miamba na mtaa wa juu mbali na bonde linalofurika utakaohamia, nenda huko mvua kubwa inapoanza milimani, na ripoti mgonjwa wa kwanza wa kuharisha maji siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C139.name: Ilemela Municipal Council
C139.documented: lake floods, large waves, boat accidents, heavy rain, and cholera

area.en: Ilemela Municipal: hillside settlements and lakeshore
area.sw: Manispaa ya Ilemela: makazi ya milimani na ufukwe

risk.en: This area has fast-growing hillside settlements among rocks and a lakeshore with landing sites, where storms cause rockfalls and floods and lightning is frequent.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina makazi yanayokua kwa kasi kwenye milima ya mawe na ufukwe wenye mialo, ambapo dhoruba husababisha miamba kuanguka na mafuriko na radi hupiga mara kwa mara.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to build on stable ground away from boulders, keep drains clear and wear life jackets on the lake. What raises the risk: cutting plots under the boulders, blocking the drains with waste, sheltering under trees or in open ground when thunder starts, and going out in overloaded boats. Know the firm ground away from the rocks that your household will move to in a heavy storm, and the sheltered landing you will run to when clouds build over the lake; get indoors, away from the shore, when thunder is heard. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kujenga kwenye ardhi imara mbali na miamba, kuweka mitaro wazi na kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa ziwani. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchonga viwanja chini ya miamba, kuziba mitaro kwa taka, kujikinga chini ya miti au uwanjani ngurumo zinapoanza, na kutoka ziwani kwa vyombo vilivyojaa kupita kiasi. Fahamu eneo imara mbali na miamba ambalo kaya yako itahamia wakati wa dhoruba kali, na mwalo uliokingwa utakaokimbilia mawingu yanapojengeka juu ya ziwa; ingia ndani, mbali na ufukwe, ngurumo zinaposikika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C138.name: Buchosa District Council
C138.documented: lake floods, large waves, boat accidents, and heavy rain

area.en: Buchosa: lake islands and fishing villages
area.sw: Buchosa: visiwa vya ziwa na vijiji vya wavuvi

risk.en: This area has islands and fishing villages where sudden lake storms capsize boats, lightning strikes fishers and unsafe water spreads cholera.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina visiwa na vijiji vya wavuvi ambapo dhoruba za ghafla ziwani hupindua vyombo, radi huwapiga wavuvi na maji yasiyo salama husambaza kipindupindu.

advice.en: For those fishing and living here, it helps to wear life jackets, return to shore before storms build and use latrines and safe water. What raises the risk: going out in overloaded or unlit boats, fishing on when clouds build over the lake, sheltering under trees when thunder starts and drinking untreated lake water. Know the sheltered landing you will run to when a storm builds, and the higher ground on the island where your village will gather if the shore floods; report the first case of watery diarrhoea the same day, because help from the mainland is slow. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaovua na kuishi hapa, ni vyema kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa, kurudi ufukweni kabla dhoruba haijaanza na kutumia vyoo na maji salama. Kinachoongeza hatari: kutoka ziwani kwa vyombo vilivyojaa kupita kiasi au visivyo na taa, kuendelea kuvua mawingu yanapojengeka juu ya ziwa, kujikinga chini ya miti ngurumo zinapoanza na kunywa maji ya ziwa yasiyotibiwa. Fahamu mwalo uliokingwa utakaokimbilia dhoruba inapojengeka, na eneo la juu kisiwani ambalo kijiji chenu kitakusanyika ufukwe ukifurika; ripoti mgonjwa wa kwanza wa kuharisha maji siku hiyo hiyo, kwa sababu msaada kutoka bara huchelewa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C136.name: Kwimba District Council
C136.documented: drought inland of the lake, flash floods in heavy rain, and strong winds

area.en: Kwimba: dry plains and seasonal rivers
area.sw: Kwimba: tambarare kame na mito ya msimu

risk.en: This area is dry farming and grazing land where dry spells cause crop losses and water shortages, and storms flood seasonal river crossings.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni ardhi kame ya kilimo na malisho ambapo vipindi vya ukavu husababisha hasara ya mazao na uhaba wa maji, na dhoruba hufurika vivuko vya mito ya msimu.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to plant drought-tolerant crops, protect water points and know the low crossings on your route. What raises the loss and the danger: ploughing the sandy soils bare, letting herds crowd the few water points, relying on one crop and driving across the flooded crossings. Agree early where the herds and the families will go for water and pasture in a dry year, and move before the animals weaken; in a storm, wait at the crossing until the water drops rather than drive through. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame, kulinda vyanzo vya maji na kujua vivuko vya chini kwenye njia zenu. Kinachoongeza hasara na hatari: kulima udongo wa mchanga hadi kuwa tupu, kuacha mifugo isongamane kwenye vyanzo vichache vya maji, kutegemea zao moja na kuvuka vivuko vilivyofurika. Kubalianeni mapema mifugo na familia zitaenda wapi kupata maji na malisho mwaka wa ukame, na hamieni kabla mifugo haijadhoofika; wakati wa dhoruba, subirini kivukoni hadi maji yapungue badala ya kuvuka. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C134.name: Magu District Council
C134.documented: Lake Victoria floods, large waves, boat accidents, and cholera

area.en: Magu: Simiyu river mouth and lakeshore
area.sw: Magu: mlango wa mto Simiyu na ufukwe

risk.en: This area has the lower Simiyu river and lakeshore plains that flood farms and villages in wet years, and fishing villages exposed to lake storms.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina sehemu ya chini ya mto Simiyu na tambarare za ufukweni zinazofurika mashamba na vijiji katika miaka ya mvua nyingi, na vijiji vya wavuvi vinavyoathiriwa na dhoruba za ziwani.

advice.en: For those living, farming and fishing here, it helps to keep homes and stores above the flood line and to wear life jackets on the lake. What raises the risk: building new houses on the Simiyu flood plain and lakeshore flats, blocking the river's outflow with bunds, and going out in overloaded boats when clouds build. Know the raised ground your village will move to when the Simiyu spreads over the plains, and move stores and animals there before the water reaches the fields; fishers, know the sheltered landing you will run to when a storm builds. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kulima na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kujenga makazi na maghala juu ya mstari wa mafuriko na kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa ziwani. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga nyumba mpya kwenye tambarare ya mafuriko ya Simiyu na tambarare za ufukweni, kuziba njia ya maji ya mto kwa matuta, na kutoka ziwani kwa vyombo vilivyojaa kupita kiasi mawingu yanapojengeka. Fahamu eneo lililoinuka ambalo kijiji chenu kitahamia Simiyu inapotapakaa tambarareni, na hamisheni akiba na mifugo huko kabla maji hayajafika mashambani; wavuvi, fahamuni mwalo uliokingwa mtakaokimbilia dhoruba inapojengeka. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C140.name: Misungwi District Council
C140.documented: lake-plain floods, heavy rain, and a marked dry season inland

area.en: Misungwi: lakeshore plains and rice fields
area.sw: Misungwi: tambarare za ufukweni na mashamba ya mpunga

risk.en: This area has low lakeshore plains and rice fields that waterlog after heavy rain, and dry inland areas where crops fail in dry spells.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina tambarare za chini za ufukweni na mashamba ya mpunga yanayojaa maji baada ya mvua kubwa, na maeneo kame ya ndani ambapo mazao hukauka wakati wa ukavu.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to build on higher ground, keep field drains open and keep household food reserves. What raises the loss in both wet and dry years: building homes and stores on the low lakeshore plains, blocking the field drains with bunds and paths, and relying on one crop. Know the higher ground your household will move to when the plains waterlog after heavy rain, and agree early, as a household and a village, where food will come from in a failed season. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga sehemu za miinuko, kuweka mifereji ya mashamba wazi na kuweka akiba ya chakula ya kaya. Kinachoongeza hasara katika miaka ya mvua nyingi na ya ukame: kujenga makazi na maghala kwenye tambarare za chini za ufukweni, kuziba mifereji ya mashamba kwa matuta na njia, na kutegemea zao moja. Fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia tambarare zinapojaa maji baada ya mvua kubwa, na kubalianeni mapema, kama kaya na kijiji, chakula kitatoka wapi msimu ukikosekana. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C137.name: Sengerema District Council
C137.documented: lake floods, large waves, boat accidents, heavy rain, and cholera

area.sw: Sengerema: ufukwe na vivuko vya feri

risk.en: This area has a long lakeshore with ferry crossings and landing sites where storms, overloading and capsizing endanger travellers and fishers.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina ufukwe mrefu wenye vivuko na mialo ambapo dhoruba, ujazaji kupita kiasi na kupinduka huhatarisha wasafiri na wavuvi.

advice.en: For those travelling and fishing here, it is safer never to board overloaded vessels, wear life jackets and wait ashore when storms are forecast. What raises the risk: boarding a ferry or boat that is already full, travelling at night or when clouds are building over the lake, and loading goods above the gunwale. Know the sheltered landing your boat will run to when a storm builds, and agree as a family that no one boards an overloaded vessel even if it means waiting a day; when a storm warning is given, stay ashore until it is lifted. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaosafiri na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kutopanda vyombo vilivyojaa kupita kiasi, kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa na kusubiri ufukweni dhoruba inapotabiriwa. Kinachoongeza hatari: kupanda kivuko au chombo kilichojaa tayari, kusafiri usiku au mawingu yanapojengeka juu ya ziwa, na kupakia mizigo juu ya ukingo wa chombo. Fahamu mwalo uliokingwa ambao chombo chenu kitakimbilia dhoruba inapojengeka, na kubalianeni kama familia kwamba hakuna anayepanda chombo kilichojaa kupita kiasi hata kama ni kusubiri siku moja; tahadhari ya dhoruba inapotolewa, kaeni ufukweni hadi iondolewe. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C133.name: Ukerewe District Council
C133.documented: large waves, boat and ferry accidents, lake floods, heavy rain, and cholera

area.sw: Ukerewe: visiwa na njia za vivuko

risk.en: This area is a group of islands reached by ferry, where lake storms make crossings dangerous, help arrives slowly and water-borne disease spreads in dense villages.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni kundi la visiwa vinavyofikiwa kwa vivuko, ambapo dhoruba za ziwani hufanya safari kuwa hatari, msaada huchelewa kufika na magonjwa yatokanayo na maji husambaa kwenye vijiji vyenye msongamano.

advice.en: For those living and travelling here, it helps to board only safe, licensed vessels, wear life jackets and keep food, water and medicine reserves. What raises the risk on islands where help is slow: crossing in unlicensed or overloaded boats, letting household reserves run out before the stormy months, and drinking untreated lake water. Know the sheltered landing your boat will run to when a storm builds and the household that holds the phone for calling help; keep food, water and medicine for the days the ferries cannot cross, and report the first case of watery diarrhoea the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kusafiri hapa, ni vyema kupanda vyombo salama vyenye leseni tu, kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa na kuweka akiba ya chakula, maji na dawa. Kinachoongeza hatari visiwani ambako msaada huchelewa: kuvuka kwa vyombo visivyo na leseni au vilivyojaa kupita kiasi, kuacha akiba za kaya ziishe kabla ya miezi ya dhoruba, na kunywa maji ya ziwa yasiyotibiwa. Fahamu mwalo uliokingwa ambao chombo chenu kitakimbilia dhoruba inapojengeka na kaya inayoshikilia simu ya kuita msaada; wekeni akiba ya chakula, maji na dawa kwa siku ambazo vivuko haviwezi kuvuka, na ripoti mgonjwa wa kwanza wa kuharisha maji siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
